concerns.text: FR-003 requires generating segregation energies for 'at least [deferred] configurations'. T017c implements a dynamic power-analysis loop stopping at N=500 or power>=0.8. There is no explicit task or logic to ensure the 'at least [deferred]' minimum count is met if the power analysis converges early, nor is there a task to document why the dynamic loop supersedes the static count requirement.

SC-001 requires measuring R² against a test set of 'at least [deferred] held-out alloy systems'. T025b defines the test set size as 'adaptive' based on available data groups. There is no task to enforce a minimum number of held-out systems or to handle the case where the available data yields fewer systems than the deferred minimum, creating a gap in satisfying the success criterion.

T019c implements streaming logic for datasets >1GB. The spec (FR-001) and plan (Assumptions) constrain the dataset to ≤500 configurations (likely <1GB) on a GitHub Actions runner. This task appears to be scope creep (gold-plating) with no corresponding requirement in the spec or plan to handle >1GB archives.

T000 (create metadata.yaml) is a blocking prerequisite for T004c (validate_citations uses metadata.yaml). Both are in Phase 1 (Setup) and marked [P] (parallel). Without a strict phase boundary or explicit dependency marker in the phase header, a parallel scheduler might execute T004c before T000 completes, causing a 'file not found' error.
